description: This file defines the EarlyRenderingControllerWrapperSubscriber class, an event subscriber in Drupal that manages early rendering of controllers to preserve bubbleable metadata such as cacheability and attachments. It wraps controller execution in a render context to prevent loss of metadata during early rendering scenarios.

classes.name: EarlyRenderingControllerWrapperSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that wraps controller execution in a render context to preserve bubbleable metadata during early rendering in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the argument resolver and renderer dependencies.

methods.name: onController
methods.description: Event handler that wraps the controller in a render context to manage early rendering.

methods.name: wrapControllerExecutionInRenderContext
methods.description: Wraps a controller's execution within a render context to capture and merge bubbleable metadata, throwing exceptions if invalid early rendering is detected.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the onController method to the KernelEvents::CONTROLLER event.
